stories.title: Portland police respond to trio of shootings overnight in the central city
stories.summary: Several people were injured but there were no deaths after a flurry of shootings early Sunday morning.

stories.title: The Grammy nominations are out. Here's where Portland fits in
stories.summary: The biggest names in music aren't the only Grammy stories worth following. Portland has a few connections of its own.

stories.title: Crash involving log truck in Astoria leaves sedan driver dead, passenger injured
stories.summary: Astoria police said that the driver of the sedan was pulling out onto West Marine Drive when they were hit by the eastbound log truck.

stories.title: Study estimates magnitude of US data center pollution as climate talks unveil clean AI pledge
stories.summary: The 400 largest data centers in the United States put as much heat-trapping gas in the air in one year as the nation of Denmark.

stories.title: Burned-out housing complex in Southeast Portland becomes a 'village' for homeless residents
stories.summary: The ruins of an abandoned building just off Southeast Foster and the Springwater Corridor Trail are a frequent campsite, despite recent intervention by the city.

stories.title: More teens are calling Washington Poison Center. AI chatbots are helping them get there
stories.summary: The Washington Poison Center says calls involving teenagers have risen roughly 50%, while the number of calls coming directly from teens has doubled.

stories.title: Washington state sees 1,100 recreational boat oil spills in five years; few face penalties
stories.summary: Washington state environmental responders were deployed to more than 1,100 oil spills involving recreational vessels in Puget Sound over five years.

stories.title: Body found in water below Yaquina Head Lighthouse in Newport
stories.summary: The U.S. Coast Guard says a body was found in the water below Yaquina Head Lighthouse in Newport on Monday. Oregon State Police is investigating.

stories.title: Washington State Patrol solves 35-year-old case, identifying woman killed in I-5 crash
stories.summary: Mary Ellen “Mollie” McCullough disappeared in 1991. Advances in DNA technology and a detective's determination finally gave her family answers about what happened.

stories.title: 4 Portland schools spared from closure, 10 still at risk as PPS parents push for state help
stories.summary: Portland Public Schools has scaled back its closure plan, but families at 10 schools remain in limbo as lawmakers weigh tapping into emergency education funds.

stories.title: Portland city workers' strike enters second week as union demands higher wages
stories.summary: Portland city workers continue to strike as negotiations remain stalled. A new state law allows the striking workers to file for unemployment benefits.

stories.title: PDX airport expects more than 380,000 travelers over Thanksgiving holiday
stories.summary: The Portland International Airport is bracing for a bustling Thanksgiving, expecting over 380,000 travelers amid rising air travel and recent FAA disruptions.
